artifact_published.description: Published a new version of an artifact.

file_edited.description: Changed a file in a meaningful way.

decision_made.description: Recorded a decision and who made it.

approval_given.description: Approved something that was waiting for approval.

claim_recorded.description: Recorded a statement or figure in a deliverable, with where it came from.

claim_verified.description: Checked a recorded claim against its source.

work_claimed.description: Took ownership of a piece of work.

work_released.description: Finished or gave up a piece of work that was claimed.

handoff_sent.description: Handed work to another person or agent.

contact_logged.description: Recorded an interaction with a client or outside party.

account_updated.description: Added a company the user deals with (client, prospect, vendor, partner), or changed its current details.

contact_updated.description: Added a person at a company, or changed their current details. Never an email, phone number or address.

deal_updated.description: Opened a deal, or changed its stage, value, owner or next step.

deal_closed.description: A deal was won or lost. The stage is the word won or lost.

alias_added.description: Recorded another name the same record goes by.

entity_merged.description: Marked this record as a duplicate of another, which is the one to use from now on.

record_updated.description: Changed the current details of any kind of record that has no verb of its own.

sequence_defined.description: Defined or revised a sequence: ordered steps, each some days after the one before. Made by rowkeep seq-define.

sequence_enrolled.description: Started taking one target through a sequence. Made by rowkeep seq-enroll.

sequence_step_done.description: Did one step of a sequence for one target. Made by rowkeep seq-step.

sequence_ended.description: Stopped a sequence for one target, with the outcome. Made by rowkeep seq-end.

review_attested.description: A person confirmed they read or reviewed something.

note_added.description: Recorded something worth keeping that fits no other verb.
